lines: Thus from emptiness to vyāna: these rests —
six bliss-levels taught; of them one connector,
l4.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ śūnyāt prabhṛti vyānāntaṃ yā etā viśrāntayaḥ tā eva nijānando nirānandaḥ parānando brahmānando mahānandaḥ cidānanda iti ṣaṭ ānandabhūmaya upadiṣṭāḥ yāsām ekaḥ anusaṃdhātā udayāstamayavihīnaḥ antarviśrāntiparamārtharūpo jagadānandaḥ

reads_against.argmap: What six bliss-levels are taught? → Six bhūmis plus a seventh (jagad-ānanda) that unites them as the connector beyond rise-and-set.
c1_essence: From emptiness to vyāna: six bliss-levels — own to consciousness — plus the connector world-bliss, rise-and-set-free.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with abhyāsa weight (quiescence as disciplined practice)
